newsitem.title: USA: ADR REPORT - Argentine ADRs inch higher.
newsitem.headline: ADR REPORT - Argentine ADRs inch higher.

text.p: Argentine shares inched higher on thin U.S. volumes Monday amid general weakness in the Dow and most Latin American markets.
"It's a little bit of a technical bounce (for Argentine ADRs). There's also some bargain-hunting. I don't think there are many more sellers around at this level," a trader said.
CS First Boston's upgrade on Banco Frances to buy from hold also helped prop up Argentine shares, which fell sharply last week on worries about the government's plan to cut its budget deficit.
